pr_title: Update TickConsolidator to process only TickType.Trade ticks
pr_body:
#### Description
The `TickConsolidator` has been updated to process `TickType.Trade` ticks only

#### Related Issue
Fixes #1818 

#### Motivation and Context
The `TickConsolidator` was considering open interest values as prices.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Unit test included + tested with a live IB futures algorithm

#### Types of changes
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/ect)

#### Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING** [document](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [x] All new and existing tests passed.
- [x] My branch follows the naming convention `bug-<issue#>-<description` or `feature-<issue#>-<description>`
pr_comments:
@FischMati You're welcome.
One question: how did you create the `ESM18` contract in your test algorithm?
`[contract.symbol = ESM18]`
It seems there is still an issue in requesting the futures contract details with the IB brokerage.

Ok, I thought you were calling `AddFutureContract` instead of `AddFuture` inside `Initialize`.

Btw, this line is not needed: 😃 
`AddFutureContract(contract.Symbol, Resolution.Tick); //Might not be needed`

I'm wondering if this consolidator should handle both trade and quote ticks. I think we already have a `TickTradeBarConsolidator` and a `TickQuoteBarConsolidator` -- so I think this consolidator's purpose was to get *all* ticks, but obviously consolidating open interest wasn't the right move. I'm thinking we should update this consolidator to process ticks and quotes.

Also, I believe this was kept like this as a point of simplicity for users. I believe most users aren't overly concerns with trades vs quotes but are more concerned with price. The `TickConsolidator` aggregates trades *and* quotes into `TradeBars` which can be used to determine the range of prices over the consolidated period which can then be used for further analysis. Also, by emitted `TradeBars`, it permits the output of the consolidator to be used with `TradeBar` dependent indicators.

@mchandschuh Currently we don't have a `TickTradeBarConsolidator`, although we could add it.
The `TickConsolidator` was created when we only supported Equities and Forex, before QuoteBars and multiple tick types were introduced.

These are the Tick consolidators we have now:
- `TickConsolidator`: processes only `TickType.Trade`, outputs `TradeBar` (fixed in this PR)
- `TickQuoteBarConsolidator`: processes only `TickType.Quote`, outputs `QuoteBar`
- `OpenInterestConsolidator`: processes only `TickType.OpenInterest`, outputs `OpenInterest`

Perhaps the class names could be made more consistent ?
Personally I prefer the single tick type processing, I believe it is also more correct:
e.g. 5-minute Tick consolidated bars should only be built using traded prices, if including quotes we will probably get different output OHLC values for bars.
